definitions.gloss: to create; to produce; to bring into being
definitions.explanation: To make something new that did not exist before. Emphasizes the creative act of bringing something into existence from nothing or from raw materials.

definitions.gloss: to generate; to give rise to; to create (an atmosphere, situation)
definitions.explanation: To cause a condition, atmosphere, or situation to come about. Used for abstract things like moods, environments, and opportunities.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make) with ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out, to begin). The ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ component adds the nuance of bringing something into existence or producing output.

A transitive verb. Compared to simple ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧, {作|つく}り{出|だ}す emphasizes the creative or generative aspect — producing something new rather than simply assembling or constructing.

- ⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to create an atmosphere
- ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to create value
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to generate profit
